sql:
SELECT b.class_symbol_id, s.name AS method_name
FROM code.class_bases b
JOIN code.symbols c ON c.symbol_id = b.class_symbol_id
JOIN code.symbols s ON s.file_id = c.file_id AND s.kind = 'method' AND s.qualname = c.qualname || '.' || s.name
WHERE b.base_symbol_id = 'auto_ontology/connectors/base.py::SQLDatabase'
  AND c.file_id NOT LIKE '%tests/%'
  AND s.name NOT LIKE '\_%' ESCAPE '\'
  AND s.name NOT IN (SELECT name FROM code.symbols WHERE kind = 'method' AND qualname LIKE 'SQLDatabase.%' AND file_id = 'auto_ontology/connectors/base.py')
GROUP BY 1, 2

ambiguities.issue: Whether the test-only subclass auto_ontology/connectors/tests/test_base.py::_Fake would contribute rows if test code were not excluded
'SQLDatabase does not define' compared by method name against SQLDatabase's own methods (incl. abstract and properties); private SQLDatabase helpers irrelevant since only public names are listed

sql:
WITH h1 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT caller_symbol_id AS s FROM code.calls
  WHERE callee_symbol_id = 'auto_ontology/utils/llm_invoke.py::invoke_with_structured_output' AND call_kind = 'direct'),
h2 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.caller_symbol_id AS s FROM code.calls c JOIN h1 ON c.callee_symbol_id = h1.s
  WHERE c.call_kind = 'direct')
SELECT h2.s AS symbol_id
FROM h2 JOIN code.symbols sy ON sy.symbol_id = h2.s JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = sy.file_id
WHERE NOT f.is_test AND h2.s NOT IN (SELECT s FROM h1)

ambiguities.issue: PiiDetector.detect calls self._backend.classify, which at runtime is LlmPiiClassifier.classify (a direct caller of the wrapper); statically this is a dynamic_attribute call with no resolved callee
ambiguities.chosen: Only statically resolved direct call edges

ambiguities.issue: Second hop including callback edges, or only high-confidence edges, or only non-test intermediates
ambiguities.chosen: Direct edges of any confidence, intermediates anywhere

sql:
WITH agents AS (
  SELECT b.class_symbol_id AS c FROM code.class_bases b
  JOIN code.symbols s ON s.symbol_id = b.class_symbol_id JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = s.file_id
  WHERE b.base_symbol_id = 'auto_ontology/retrieval/text_to_sql/base.py::BaseAgent' AND NOT f.is_test),
ctor AS (
  SELECT k.callee_symbol_id AS c, f.is_test FROM code.calls k
  JOIN code.symbols cs ON cs.symbol_id = k.caller_symbol_id JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = cs.file_id
  WHERE k.call_kind = 'direct')
SELECT a.c AS class_symbol_id FROM agents a
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ctor WHERE ctor.c = a.c AND NOT ctor.is_test)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ctor WHERE ctor.c = a.c AND ctor.is_test)

ambiguities.issue: 'Constructed anywhere in test code' read transitively: tests call text_to_sql create_graph() and CombinedPrecheckAgent(), which construct ResponseAgent, EmptyLikeResultCheckAgent, KumoPredictionAgent, PredictionGraphAgent, JoinPathCheckAgent, JsonbPathCheckAgent and ProactiveValueCheckAgent
ambiguities.chosen: Direct constructor calls only (as the wording 'called by name' implies)

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT k.caller_symbol_id AS symbol_id
FROM code.calls k JOIN code.symbols sy ON sy.symbol_id = k.caller_symbol_id JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = sy.file_id
WHERE k.callee_symbol_id = 'auto_ontology/dal/session.py::write_transaction' AND k.call_kind = 'direct'
  AND NOT f.is_test AND sy.file_id NOT LIKE 'auto_ontology/dal/%'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code.calls k2 WHERE k2.caller_symbol_id = k.caller_symbol_id
                  AND k2.callee_symbol_id = 'auto_ontology/dal/session.py::store' AND k2.call_kind = 'direct')

ambiguities.issue: store()/write_transaction called through the module alias pg_session.store / pg_session.write_transaction
ambiguities.chosen: Counted as direct calls (resolved by import)

sql:
SELECT s.symbol_id, COUNT(DISTINCT k.caller_symbol_id)::INTEGER AS caller_count
FROM code.symbols s JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = s.file_id
JOIN code.calls k ON k.callee_symbol_id = s.symbol_id AND k.call_kind = 'direct'
JOIN code.symbols cs ON cs.symbol_id = k.caller_symbol_id JOIN code.files cf ON cf.file_id = cs.file_id
WHERE s.kind = 'function' AND s.file_id LIKE 'auto_ontology/dal/%' AND NOT f.is_test
  AND s.file_id <> 'auto_ontology/dal/session.py'
  AND NOT cf.is_test AND cs.file_id NOT LIKE 'auto_ontology/dal/%'
GROUP BY s.symbol_id
ORDER BY caller_count DESC, s.symbol_id ASC
LIMIT 5

ambiguities.issue: Tie at the 5th place: fetch_schemas_by_ids, fetch_all_terms and fetch_column_attributes_by_term_id all have 6 callers; 'five' with the symbol-ID tie-break keeps only fetch_schemas_by_ids, while a with-ties reading returns all three
ambiguities.chosen: Strict top 5 by count desc, symbol_id asc

ambiguities.issue: Including callback references as callers, or including test callers (assemble_export_document jumps to 12 with tests)
ambiguities.chosen: Direct calls from non-test callers only (as worded)

sql:
SELECT s.kind, COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS public_count
FROM code.symbols s JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = s.file_id
WHERE s.file_id LIKE 'auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/%' AND NOT f.is_test AND s.is_public
GROUP BY s.kind

WITH RECURSIVE chain(c, d) AS (
  SELECT class_symbol_id, 1 FROM code.class_bases WHERE base_symbol_id = 'auto_ontology/server/models.py::ApiModel'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT b.class_symbol_id, chain.d + 1 FROM code.class_bases b JOIN chain ON b.base_symbol_id = chain.c WHERE chain.d < 20)
SELECT c AS class_symbol_id, MIN(d)::INTEGER AS depth FROM chain GROUP BY c HAVING MIN(d) >= 2
